prompts.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite for a 2D side-scrolling platform adventure. Image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a background or layout to copy. Preserve this exact white-haired green-eyed dragon girl's horns, small white dragon wings, white roses, white and pale mint dress, green gemstone details and white dragon tail. Translate her into a clearly readable full-body chibi approximately three heads tall. Pose: neutral standing idle, body facing RIGHT in side/three-quarter view, both complete legs and small white ankle boots visible, arms relaxed, curious confident expression. Tail and hair trail toward the left, compact silhouette. Clean expressive anime linework, soft hand-painted shading, simplified details suitable for an 80px-tall game character. Entire figure including horns, wings, tail and feet must fit within a square canvas with comfortable transparent margins. Character centered horizontally, soles aligned at 88% of canvas height, horns near 10%, fixed camera at torso height, no perspective distortion. Truly transparent RGBA background; no white backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground, no cast shadow, no labels, no text, no other characters. This is a single isolated full-body standing character, not a sheet of poses. Keep modest dress with opaque coverage.

Image 1 is the approved CHARACTER MASTER. Create ONE new matching transparent game sprite of this exact dragon girl RUNNING TO THE RIGHT. Keep the identical face, white hair, white horns, tiny white wings, green eyes, rose ornaments, white and mint dress, gemstone accessories, tail and white ankle boots. Same chibi proportions, same clean anime linework and painted shading. Change only her pose to a readable energetic running contact pose: torso leaning gently forward, arms counter-swinging, rightward/front leg extended forward and back leg pushing off, hair and tail lagging naturally to the left. Entire character and both feet fully visible. A SINGLE RUNNING POSE, NOT a multi-frame sheet. Square canvas, same camera scale as Image 1, the character's full vertical silhouette roughly 90% of canvas, lower shoe near the same bottom baseline as reference, enough clearance around horns/tail/wings. True transparent RGBA background. No floor, no cast shadow, no motion streaks, no surrounding magic, no words or watermark. Preserve modest opaque clothing. Designed to remain legible at 80 pixels tall.

Create ONE wide landscape BACKGROUND PLATE for a cheerful 2D side-scrolling anime platform game about an AI hallucinating a fantasy world. Image 1 is a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: match its delicate hand-painted anime shading and white/mint/lilac palette, but DO NOT include this character or any people. Scene: dreamy floating-island sky, distant small mint grassy islands with soft lavender stone undersides suspended at different heights, wispy fluffy clouds, pale blue atmospheric layers, faint impossible architecture and an upside-down distant waterfall as gentle visual absurdity. Warm, playful, lightly surreal, not gloomy. Wide panoramic composition about 2.3:1. The lower half must remain mostly open pale blue/lilac atmosphere so separately drawn game platforms and characters read clearly. All islands are SMALL and FAR AWAY; no foreground ground, no nearby bridge, no platform surface crossing the image, no doors or collectible stars. Soft low contrast scenery, crisp illustrative craftsmanship without pixel art, no heavy texture, no interface, no text, no logos, no borders. Opaque background image with edge-to-edge sky. This is a runtime background asset, not a mockup or complete gameplay screenshot.

Create ONE full-body game character sprite of the DeepSeek whale-maid girl. Image 1 is the PRIMARY identity reference: preserve her cobalt-to-cyan long hair, blue eyes, small whale-fin ears, single curved ahoge, cyan bow, white ruffled maid headband, navy and white outfit and blue oval neck gemstone. Image 2 is a supporting full-body costume and whale-tail reference. Make a polished chibi approximately 2.7 heads tall, clean anime linework, lively readable shapes, soft cel shading. Pose: standing idle facing RIGHT, body mostly side-on with a three-quarter face looking toward the right, BOTH eyes open, cheerful slightly overconfident smile, arms relaxed and free. Keep the navy knee-length modest maid dress, white apron with a small whale emblem, white ankle socks and dark rounded shoes, and a curved blue whale tail behind her. No bowl, chopsticks or hand-held objects: her hands must be free for platform adventure movement. Entire figure including headband, ahoge, hair, feet and tail visible in one square canvas; no clipping. Fixed orthographic-ish camera; character occupies about 80% canvas height, feet on a shared baseline at 90%, generous transparent margins. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no checkerboard drawing, no text, no watermark, no border, no extra people. Single pose only, no contact sheet. This sprite will be viewed at about 80 pixels high, so simplify tiny clothing patterns while preserving the character identity.

Image 1 is the APPROVED full-body DeepSeek whale-maid character master. Generate ONE matching sprite in a RUNNING CONTACT POSE FACING RIGHT. Preserve exactly her cobalt-to-cyan long hair, open blue eyes, whale-fin ears, curved ahoge, cyan bow, white ruffled headband, navy long-sleeved maid dress, white apron with small whale emblem, blue oval neck gemstone, white ankle socks, dark rounded shoes, and blue whale tail. Same cute chibi proportions, same head size, clean linework, vivid restrained anime cel shading. Change only pose: lean forward slightly, arms counter-swing, one leg reaches forward right and the other pushes backward left, hair and tail follow behind. Whole body fully visible; feet, ahoge and tail are not cropped. Square canvas, consistent figure scale and baseline with the master, generous transparent padding. No additional props. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no fake checkerboard, no text or watermark. A SINGLE running key pose, NOT a sprite sheet or multiple poses. A legible, energetic 2D platform game sprite.

Create ONE isolated platform terrain asset for a 2D side-scrolling game. Image 1 is a PALETTE AND PAINTING STYLE reference only. Asset: a wide rectangular floating earth-and-stone block with a pale mint grassy top lip and a soft lavender-gray faceted stone front/underside, tiny restrained white flowers near the two ends, a few short hanging roots. Clean hand-painted anime fantasy look, slightly toy-like but not 3D plastic. STRICT SIDE ELEVATION, no isometric perspective, no visible receding top plane. The walkable top edge must be perfectly straight and horizontal along the entire usable width, no hills, tall plants, rocks or objects on the walking line. Wide landscape canvas about 3:1; one block spans about 92% width, body is relatively shallow. Clear complete rectangular silhouette, transparent margin around it. No attached clouds or ground shadow, no scenery, no characters, no labels, no text, no borders. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. The image will be stretched or cropped into different platform lengths, so keep the center simple and repeatable.

Create ONE isolated fantasy bridge platform sprite for a 2D side-scrolling game, using Image 1 ONLY as an anime-painted palette/style reference. Asset: a slim horizontal magical bridge deck made of pale lilac crystal-and-wood planks, tiny warm gold connectors, delicate mint edge highlights. It should look charming and almost too perfect, suitable for a hallucinated bridge that will disappear via code. STRICT SIDE ELEVATION: walkable surface is a perfectly straight horizontal line, constant height across the entire span. NO arches, no handrails, no posts above the deck, no perspective recession. A single complete bridge span with short matching end caps and a shallow decorative underside. Wide landscape canvas, bridge itself very wide and thin, around 7:1 object proportions, centered with transparent padding. Solid opaque bridge materials; do not fade the deck or break it apart, disappearance is animated in code. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. No ground, no rocks below, no clouds, no separate islands, no cast shadow, no words, no logo, no characters. Clean small-scale-readable detail, no sheet of variants.
